run.question:
Alertmanager alert PendingPodsDetected (severity critical) is firing for service otel-demo/otel-demo since 2026-11-15T10:41:06Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The PendingPodsDetected alert for namespace otel-demo (annotation 'current: 2') is explained by exactly two unschedulable pods, ad-dd7f45975-mw86p and cart-5b597c6db5-pkzkh, created by a configuration-only rollout of the 'ad' and 'cart' Deployments at 2026-11-15T10:40:09Z and 10:40:17Z. Both new ReplicaSets and their pods carry pod-template nodeSelector kubernetes.io/hostname=invalid-node, and none of the 5 cluster nodes has that hostname label, so the scheduler reports PodScheduled=False/Unschedulable for both pods and the rolling updates are stuck with one surge pod each. The previous ReplicaSet pods of ad and cart are still Ready and still back the Service endpoints, so this is pending surge capacity rather than lost service capacity. Node capacity, taints and pod resource requests were checked and do not explain the pending state. The identity of the change author (change history is not integrated) and the exact alerting expression (no such rule loaded) could not be verified.

claims.text: In namespace otel-demo exactly two pods are Pending: ad-dd7f45975-mw86p and cart-5b597c6db5-pkzkh; the remaining 21 pods are Running. This matches the alert annotation 'current: 2'.

Both pending pods have condition PodScheduled=False with reason Unschedulable and message '0/5 nodes are available: 1 node(s) had untolerated taint {node-role.kubernetes.io/control-plane: }, 4 node(s) didn't match Pod's node affinity/selector. preemption: 0/5 nodes are available: 5 Preemption is not helpful for scheduling.', and both have empty containerStatuses (containers never started).
The pending pod specs contain nodeSelector {"kubernetes.io/hostname":"invalid-node"} with no affinity and no nodeName; they are owned by ReplicaSets ad-dd7f45975 and cart-5b597c6db5 respectively.

The cluster has 5 nodes with kubernetes.io/hostname values i-01a47734339426210, i-037e40963128cbd9f, i-0424ef08cd107882f, i-08831c4b8af18ed15 and i-097278082719f10ba; none equals 'invalid-node'. Only i-01a47734339426210 (control-plane) carries a NoSchedule taint; the other four are untainted workers.

Among the 21 Deployments in otel-demo, only 'ad' and 'cart' define a pod-template nodeSelector, and in both it is {"kubernetes.io/hostname":"invalid-node"}. Both declare spec.replicas=1 but show status.replicas=2, unavailableReplicas=1 and Progressing condition reason ReplicaSetUpdated, i.e. a stalled rolling update.

New ReplicaSets ad-dd7f45975 (created 2026-11-15T10:40:09Z) and cart-5b597c6db5 (created 2026-11-15T10:40:17Z), owned by Deployments ad and cart, use unchanged images ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-ad and :2.1.3-cart, carry nodeSelector kubernetes.io/hostname=invalid-node and have no ready replicas; the prior ReplicaSets ad-554b849958 and cart-755465879b have no nodeSelector and still hold 1 ready replica each.

Events show Deployment 'ad' ScalingReplicaSet ad-dd7f45975 0->1 and ReplicaSet SuccessfulCreate 'Created pod: ad-dd7f45975-mw86p' at 10:40:09Z, Deployment 'cart' ScalingReplicaSet cart-5b597c6db5 0->1 and SuccessfulCreate 'Created pod: cart-5b597c6db5-pkzkh' at 10:40:17Z, and repeated Warning FailedScheduling for both pods (lastTimestamp 10:50:32Z) carrying the taint/selector message; the alert start 10:41:06Z follows the first rollout by about one minute.

Deployments 'ad' and 'cart' are Helm-managed (meta.helm.sh/release-name=otel-demo) at metadata.generation 2 and deployment.kubernetes.io/revision 2, with RollingUpdate maxSurge 25% / maxUnavailable 25%, which is why one extra surge pod per Deployment exists and stays Pending while the previous pod remains serving.

The Endpoints objects for Services 'ad' and 'cart' each contain one ready address pointing at pre-change pods ad-554b849958-42mdm and cart-755465879b-bgb2p, with no notReadyAddresses, so traffic was still routed to the old pods at observation time.

The pending pods request only 10m CPU / 225Mi memory (ad) and 15m CPU / 55Mi memory (cart), with limits 50m/450Mi and 45m/165Mi, while each worker node advertises 4 CPU and roughly 16Gi allocatable memory.

Service 'ad' recorded 3.046875 error-status spans versus 4387.68 UNSET-status spans across the 09:41-10:56 window; the sampled error spans are ad-side flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/EventStream spans with otel.status_code=ERROR and rpc.grpc.status_code=4, lasting ~596s and ~600s, started around 10:08:38Z and 10:18:35Z (before the 10:40 rollout), and their flagd child spans returned rpc.grpc.status_code=0.

Root cause: the otel-demo Helm release was modified to add nodeSelector kubernetes.io/hostname=invalid-node to the 'ad' and 'cart' pod templates (Deployment revision 2, 10:40:09Z and 10:40:17Z). Because the images are unchanged, this is a configuration-only change, and every newly created surge pod is unschedulable on all 5 nodes, which is exactly what the alert counts as 2 Pending pods.

The 21 other otel-demo pods are Running on nodes i-037e40963128cbd9f, i-0424ef08cd107882f and i-097278082719f10ba without any nodeSelector, and the cluster-wide Pending pod list contains only the two ad/cart pods, so this is not a cluster-wide scheduling outage and the worker nodes are functioning.

Rejected: insufficient CPU/memory capacity on the nodes. The scheduler message for both pods names only an untolerated control-plane taint and a node selector mismatch, and the pending pods' requests (10m/225Mi and 15m/55Mi) are far below the four worker nodes' 4 CPU and ~16Gi allocatable each.

Rejected: the control-plane NoSchedule taint is the cause. It affects only 1 of 5 nodes and is standard, while four untainted worker nodes exist and already run the 21 running otel-demo pods; the pods' own condition attributes the block to node affinity/selector on four nodes.

Rejected: image pull failure or container crash-loop causing Pending. Neither pod has containerStatuses or a nodeName, and the otel-demo events contain no ErrImagePull/ImagePullBackOff and no container restart; the only warning events are FailedScheduling for these two pods.

Correct the nodeSelector in the otel-demo Helm values: remove kubernetes.io/hostname=invalid-node from the 'ad' and 'cart' pod templates (or point it at an existing hostname such as i-037e40963128cbd9f, i-0424ef08cd107882f, i-08831c4b8af18ed15 or i-097278082719f10ba) so the rolling update can complete and replace the two Pending pods; a faster recovery is 'kubectl rollout undo deployment/ad deployment/cart -n otel-demo'. No change or remediation was executed in this investigation.

No alerting rule named PendingPodsDetected was found in the Prometheus rule listing (b5c22ea0-1f29-4663-96cf-1014afe93acc-t1:0008d1b7-ea19-4944-8d84-b82bd85a2545 and d6195771-5484-465a-a0ce-b00492807f86-t2:a7558425-ce80-4d42-b987-55ba93b69744 both returned no data), so the alert's exact expression, threshold and 'for' duration were not verified.

Change history is listed as not integrated in this Run, so who or what introduced nodeSelector kubernetes.io/hostname=invalid-node (Helm values edit, pipeline or manual patch) could not be verified; only the resulting revision-2 Deployments and their events are observable.

Full trace searches for services ad and cart exceeded the result limit and were replaced by error-tag-filtered samples, so per-operation latency and overall failure rates for ad/cart were not measured; no latency trend is asserted.

Service 'cart' error-tag trace search returned no data (cd33f562-e3db-4b6c-97e0-c61b0dc88a52-t1:4daaaf80-2718-4e0d-ad93-d70cd18a3cc5) and its only status label value is STATUS_CODE_UNSET, so whether cart emitted error spans is unknown, not zero.

ResourceQuota listing for otel-demo returned no items (ce6328a4-6be7-455e-b22b-fbe72b779147-t0:af1e8a67-6aa4-4410-89f6-220f2c78aea3, status no_data), so quota constraints cannot be asserted either way.

Because objects are the cluster state at query time (~10:56Z) and events only cover 10:40:09Z-10:50:32Z, the exact moment the Pending pods first appeared, and whether they existed before 10:40Z, are not proven beyond the rollout events.
next_steps: Review the otel-demo Helm release values and history for the 'ad' and 'cart' charts around 2026-11-15T10:40Z to identify who added nodeSelector kubernetes.io/hostname=invalid-node, then revert it via the release pipeline.

After correcting the nodeSelector, confirm ReplicaSets ad-dd7f45975 and cart-5b597c6db5 become Ready and that ad-dd7f45975-mw86p and cart-5b597c6db5-pkzkh disappear; if values cannot be fixed immediately, use kubectl rollout undo on both Deployments.

Add rollout-stuck or replicas-unavailable alerting for these Deployments, since the current alert only surfaces the symptom of unschedulable pods and the ad/cart services kept serving from the old pods.
